build.beforeBuildCommand: pnpm build:desktop-sidecar && pnpm build && node scripts/ensure-public-assets.mjs

security.csp: default-src 'self' customprotocol: asset:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost http://localhost:* http://127.0.0.1:* ws://localhost:* ws://127.0.0.1:* https: wss:; img-src 'self' asset: http: https: data: blob:; media-src 'self' http: https: data: blob:; font-src 'self' data: https:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self' https://www.googletagmanager.com https://www.google-analytics.com 'unsafe-inline'; frame-src 'self' https:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'

bundle.longDescription: Aplikasi desktop lintas platform untuk mengakses dan mengelola Codeverta Enterprise System.
